verdict.rationale: Riveter's enrichment engine explicitly processes rows of URLs with scraping, runs asynchronously (webhook_url on completion), and SDKs handle retries, long-polling, and pagination — all core pieces for async batch scraping. However, there's no explicit documentation of scale limits, concurrency handling, or a tested example at thousands-of-URLs volume. Missing for 10: explicit large-scale (thousands of URLs) benchmarks or case studies, concurrency/rate-limit guidance for very large batches.
